title: HackerEarth: Palindromic String
description: You have been given a String `s`. You need to find whether it is a palindrome or not. Return 'YES' or 'NO'.
solution:
def is_palindrome(s: str) -> str:
    return 'YES' if s == s[::-1] else 'NO'
explanation: Checks if string equals its reverse in O(N) time.
